---
title: "ERM — Wikibase Mapping Diagram"
subtitle: "Entity-Relationship Model for the ClimateKG Wikibase data model"
---

This diagram maps the IPCC AR6 XML/DTD entities to their corresponding Wikibase
properties (PIDs) and class items (QIDs) on the local ClimateKG Wikibase instance.

Source file: [`er-diagram-wikibase.mmd`](er-diagram-wikibase.mmd) — regenerate by
running `generate-erm.ps1` whenever [`erm-wikibase-mapping.xml`](erm-wikibase-mapping.xml) changes.

::: {#erm-diagram-wrapper}
```{mermaid}
%%| file: er-diagram-wikibase.mmd
```
:::

```{=html}
     href="https://mermaidviewer.com/share/vM7HKbpLsxMF44EMalvNI"

</div>

<!-- Fullscreen modal -->
<div id="erm-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="ERM diagram fullscreen">
  <div id="erm-modal-backdrop"></div>
  <div id="erm-modal-inner">
    <div id="erm-modal-toolbar">

      <div id="erm-modal-controls">
        <button class="erm-btn" id="erm-zoom-in" title="Zoom in">+</button>

        <button class="erm-btn" id="erm-zoom-reset" title="Reset view">Reset</button>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
.erm-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  gap: .6rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin: .4rem 0 1.4rem;
}
.erm-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: .35rem .8rem;
  border: 1px solid #6c757d;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: .85rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #212529;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-family: inherit;
}
.erm-btn:hover { background: #e2e6ea; border-color: #495057; }

/* Modal */
#erm-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9000;
}
#erm-modal-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.78);
}
#erm-modal-inner {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 2vh 2vw;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
#erm-modal-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: .45rem .75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .4rem;
}
#erm-modal-hint { color: #6c757d; font-size: .78rem; }
#erm-modal-controls { display: flex; gap: .35rem; }
#erm-modal-viewport {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: grab;
  position: relative;
  background: #fafafa;
}
#erm-modal-viewport.dragging { cursor: grabbing; user-select: none; }
#erm-modal-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform-origin: 0 0;
}
#erm-modal-canvas svg { display: block; max-width: none !important; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var scale = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0;
  var dragging = false, startX, startY, startTx, startTy;

  function canvas()   { return document.getElementById('erm-modal-canvas'); }
  function viewport() { return document.getElementById('erm-modal-viewport'); }

  function applyTransform() {
    var c = canvas();
    if (!c) return;
    c.style.transform =
      'translate(calc(-50% + ' + tx + 'px), calc(-50% + ' + ty + 'px)) scale(' + scale + ')';
  }

  function zoom(factor, pivotX, pivotY) {
    var prev = scale;
    scale = Math.min(10, Math.max(0.15, scale * factor));
    var r = scale / prev;
    tx = pivotX + (tx - pivotX) * r;
    ty = pivotY + (ty - pivotY) * r;
    applyTransform();
  }

  function openModal() {
    var src = document.querySelector('#erm-diagram-wrapper svg');
    if (!src) {
      alert('Diagram not yet rendered — please wait a moment and try again.');
      return;
    }
    var c = canvas();
    c.innerHTML = '';
    var clone = src.cloneNode(true);
    clone.removeAttribute('style');
    var r = src.getBoundingClientRect();
    clone.style.width  = (r.width  || 900) + 'px';
    clone.style.height = (r.height || 600) + 'px';
    c.appendChild(clone);
    scale = 1; tx = 0; ty = 0;
    applyTransform();
    document.getElementById('erm-modal').style.display = 'block';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('erm-modal').style.display = 'none';
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.getElementById('erm-fullscreen-btn').addEventListener('click', openModal);
    document.getElementById('erm-modal-close').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    document.getElementById('erm-modal-backdrop').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal(); });

    document.getElementById('erm-zoom-in').addEventListener('click',    function () { zoom(1.3,  0, 0); });
    document.getElementById('erm-zoom-out').addEventListener('click',   function () { zoom(1/1.3, 0, 0); });
    document.getElementById('erm-zoom-reset').addEventListener('click', function () { scale = 1; tx = 0; ty = 0; applyTransform(); });

    var vp = viewport();

    vp.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var rect = vp.getBoundingClientRect();
      zoom(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 1/1.12,
           e.clientX - rect.left  - rect.width  / 2,
           e.clientY - rect.top   - rect.height / 2);
    }, { passive: false });

    vp.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      dragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY;
      startTx = tx; startTy = ty;
      vp.classList.add('dragging');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
      if (!dragging) return;
      tx = startTx + (e.clientX - startX);
      ty = startTy + (e.clientY - startY);
      applyTransform();
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', function () {
      if (!dragging) return;
      dragging = false;
      var v = viewport();
      if (v) v.classList.remove('dragging');
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Corpus hierarchy (QID reference)

| Entity | QID | Wikibase label | Also known as |
|--------|-----|----------------|---------------|
| `WORK` | Q2 | Work | |
| `REPORT_SERIES` | Q3 | Report Series | Monographic Series |
| `REPORT` | Q4 | Report | Book; Monograph; Volume |
| `TEXT_DIVISION` | Q5 | Text Division | Division |
| `CHAPTER` | Q6 | Chapter | |
| `AUTHOR` | Q3998 | Author | |
| `GLOSSARY_TERM` | Q1 | Category | Glossary Terms |
| `ACRONYM` | Q2087 | Acronym | |

See the [ERM documentation](README.md) for the full property reference (P1–P33) and
workflow for updating the mapping.
